name: os-installation-tool
description: Create bootable Windows 11 and Linux USB drives from any OS, with zero-touch unattended setup and privacy hardening baked in.

comments.why-no-workspaces: This repo lives on a mapped network drive that cannot create symlinks, so npm workspaces fail with EPERM/UNKNOWN on symlink. Each package installs its own dependencies and imports shared code by relative path; esbuild inlines it at build time.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/shared install && npm --prefix packages/server install && npm --prefix packages/agent install && npm --prefix packages/web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix packages/server run build && npm --prefix packages/agent run build && npm --prefix packages/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/shared run test && npm --prefix packages/server run test && npm --prefix packages/agent run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/server run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/agent run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/web run typecheck
